comparison.objective: Repose two friction-jointed helping-hands fixtures so two wire ends cross over a marked location.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulating coupled passive joints by their clip bodies and coordinating two retained wire ends; no striking or loose-part recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Wire ends must cross over the yellow mark and both fixtures must remain after release. Numeric crossing, contact, release, and stability tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests coupled pose adjustment and maintained alignment, not fracture mechanics or containment.
